name: Config B development protocol (pre-registration amendment)
not_an_amendment_to: docs/preregistration/cse_cic_ids2018.json (Config B's identity reaches it only by a later signed amendment carrying frozen_identities.config_b, before Phase 5)
config_b_identity_rule: recorded by a signed addendum after implementation and before stage 1; the addendum records hashes only and cannot change protocol content

scope.unsw_nb15: no Config B fit; B = B0 = A by construction (no mapping qualified); Config A values reused unchanged and labelled as Config A results
scope.claim_limit: single-dataset intervention on improved CICIDS2017; not cross-dataset validation

simulator.blue: SleepAgent, Sleep, all five blue agents

scenario_bank.episodes: 50 per fold seed for fold seeds 0-4 (250 episodes, not 250 independent seeds)
scenario_bank.pre_run_check: every log sha256 and every per-seed mapped count equal the manifest, or stop

reproducibility.byte_for_byte: fold seed 0 trajectory hash equals the spike's final-probe hash
reproducibility.behavioural_only: seeds 2 and 3 equal the spike's behavioural counts; hashes differ because the spike predates sub_action logging
reproducibility.recorded_only: every other episode; its log checksum is its reference

scenario_bank.description: CAGE 4 scripted red against sleeping blue; not a representative real-world attacker population; not an independent validation set
scenario_bank.incident: 2026-11-10 accidental builder run: all 250 logs verified, manifest byte-identical (same sha256), git state unchanged; accepted as verification only (issue 26)

rejected.SQLInjection -> web_attack: E4: 9 SQL-injection rows of 62 web_attack training rows (seed 0), below the pre-set floor of 20; threshold not lowered

outcome_rules.O2: executed, reached a service, succeeded: once, as an attempt
outcome_rules.O3: executed, reached a service, failed: once, as an attempt
outcome_rules.O4: failed before reaching any service: not counted; reported as unreachable failed exploits

mapping.scenario_limits: mapped 32,215 of 297,626 red actions (10.8%; 11.4% with the rejected SQLInjection); Impact and DegradeServices 61%; weights nearly constant across fold seeds

arms.same_records: A, B and B0 share Config A's capped distinct training rows; copies added on top
arms.A: Config A through the Config B wrapper with zero replay
arms.B: replay total r x (capped training rows of seen mapped families), split by event weights, cyclic without replacement within family, at most 4 replays per row (truncated, not redistributed; kept as a guard)
arms.B0: exactly B's realized total, cyclic without replacement over the whole seen attack pool, same cap; adds nothing where B adds nothing
arms.encoding: integer copies of preprocessed distinct rows; no sample_weight; class_weight balanced_subsample kept
arms.preprocessing: fitted once on distinct training rows by Config A's procedure; identical parameters for A, B, B0
arms.invariants: plan section 7 checks 1-6, before every fit; any failure stops execution with no correction, retry or fallback
arms.tests: T1-T10 (plan section 7) must pass before any stage

selection.rule: aegis.experiments.selection majority rule at 1% target FPR, applied to B and B0 separately; inner B0 matches inner B's realized total at each ratio

analysis.primary: per held-out family, mean per-seed paired difference recall_B - recall_B0, raw view, 1% target FPR, seeds 0-4; 95% bootstrap (10,000), two-sided Wilcoxon, Cohen's d_z
analysis.classification: positive if the 95% interval lies entirely above zero, negative if entirely below, inconclusive if it includes zero; no numerical minimum effect size (the shortcut rule's 0.10 is not a Config B threshold); actual mean difference, interval and d_z always reported; a classification is not a claim of practical importance

two_family.role: the only folds where B's simulator-derived split is active

single_family.role: replay goes to the remaining mapped family; cannot establish a benefit from simulator-derived weighting; none claimed

neither_family.role: controls: B = B0 = A by construction; identical inner recall required, a difference stops the run as an invariant failure

fold_groups.inner_notation: (outer held-out family, inner held-out family); trains on the other two
fold_groups.pooling: groups reported separately; no pooled estimate across held-out families

analysis.held_out_family_limitation: when brute_force or portscan is held out the other mapped family receives all replay; simulator weights add no distinction beyond selecting it; no weighting benefit is claimed from those folds
secondary: B - A and B0 - A per family
analysis.shortcut_audit: primary treatments and the unchanged rule, applied to fresh A under 25685b84dd83f65c, B and B0; Phase 1 verdicts not revised
analysis.five_seed_limitation: minimum attainable two-sided Wilcoxon p with 5 seeds is 0.0625; effect sizes and intervals are read first; p-values never make a claim alone; bootstrap over 5 seeds is coarse
analysis.interpretation: B - B0 is the effect of the specified replay-composition policies (CAGE-derived split over mapped seen families vs size-proportional over the seen attack pool; in the bot fold B0 is about 92% dos), not an isolated causal effect of simulator information

determinism: same-environment rerun of A, B, B0 outer folds for all seeds; every non-timing column must match exactly; no tolerance set in advance or added afterwards; a mismatch is reported as failed
perturbation_arm: excluded entirely (owner, 2026-11-10); stage 6 does not run; no operators defined and no perturbed records generated or reported

compute.accounting: measured process CPU (RUSAGE_SELF, RUSAGE_CHILDREN), ledger per fit and stage, re-projection before every stage
compute.machine: local only, no GPU, no cloud
compute.stage_6: excluded; the 2.7 CPU-h difference is not freed for other work
compute.overrun_rule: from stage 2 on, before every stage: if measured plus re-projected exceeds 71.5, stop before the next stage and request owner approval with measured consumption per stage, remaining-stage estimates, the reason for the increase and proposed changes
compute.hard_limits: 153 and 180 are hard limits, not permission to exceed 71.5; above 153 needs explicit owner authorization beyond any 71.5 approval; nothing crosses 180
compute.estimate_script: spikes/cage4/estimate.py --scope cicids (its stage-6 row is not run)

revision: 2 (2026-11-10): owner decisions on section 14 recorded; fold groups separated
decisions_recorded: 1. perturbation arm excluded entirely; stage 6 does not run
2. no numerical minimum effect size; positive / negative / inconclusive from the interval; effects and intervals always reported
3. 71.5 CPU-h approved planning budget; exceeding projection stops for approval; 153 and 180 hard limits
4. two-family, single-family and neither-family folds kept separate; results described as effects of the specified replay-composition policies
5. scenario bank accidental run accepted as verification only (docs/issue_history.md, issue 26)
